{% comment %}
  The LLM-readable version of the site. It mirrors what a visitor can reach by
  clicking: the homepage (in section order), Writing, Speaking and the CV.
  Every section reads from the same _data / collection source as its HTML, so
  the two cannot drift apart. Do not add content here that is not on the site.
